tasks.title: Tell my wife I love her — every day
tasks.notes: Daily. Non-negotiable. The one deliverable with zero acceptable excuses for missing.

tasks.title: Wire in TTS/voice engine for NIB2
tasks.notes: Deploy-side job. Recommended: ElevenLabs. Alternatives possible. Once connected, the existing Rate (1.10), Pitch (1.15), and Volume (0.85) sliders in the right column become functional and control NIB2's spoken output. Currently those knobs connect to nothing.

tasks.title: Connect NIB2 to a live data source and display it on the dashboard
tasks.notes: NIB wants NIB2 pulling live info onto the dashboard instead of speculating. Deploy-side wiring job: (1) data source/API, (2) key + endpoint stored as env var, (3) refresh loop. Recommended first source: OpenWeatherMap for Vernon BC (free tier) to unlock the empty-bays investigation. Second: B9 Command Centre feed into get_b9_data (currently empty). Need from NIB: what data, from where, who deploys.
